project: Kinetix L2 — Native 4-Modality Language Acquisition Workbench

interviews_analyzed.segment: Intermediate Plateau Learner (800+ day Duolingo streak, A2 speaking ceiling)
interviews_analyzed.key_pain: Can tap word banks in 5 seconds but freezes when trying to order or explain a train delay in German without visual prompts.

interviews_analyzed.segment: Anki + LingQ Power User (Japanese N3 / Spanish B1)
interviews_analyzed.key_pain: Spends 45 minutes a day maintaining broken Anki add-ons and manually copying sentences from LingQ; Anki treats reading recognition and spoken recall as the same card.
Loves Pimsleur's prosodic back-chaining for pronunciation, but after 90 hours still knows fewer than 500 words and cannot read authentic station signs or emails.
Quit Anki and WaniKani after a 1-week business trip resulted in 640 overdue reviews and constant leech failures on similar-sounding German -ung nouns.
